stories.title: Rasmussen silences Yankees with near no-hitter in Game 1 win
stories.summary: Drew Rasmussen and Bryan Baker pitched a one-hit game Saturday night as the Rays shut down the Yankees' offense to take Game 1 of their ALDS series.

stories.title: Skubal 'as advertised' in brilliant opener, stakes Dodgers to 1-0 NLDS lead
stories.summary: Tarik Skubal allowed one run in six dominant innings, retiring 15 straight batters in one stretch, and the Dodgers beat the Braves 5-3 on Saturday in Game 1 of their NL Division Series.

stories.title: UFC 332 smashes record with nine first-round knockouts, 11 total finishes
stories.summary: It was a record-setting night at UFC 332, which featured nine first-round knockouts and 11 total finishes, both the most ever on a single card.

stories.title: Fever GM defends fanbase: Attacks have no basis in reality, must stop
stories.summary: General manager Amber Cox defended the Fever fanbase during her end-of-season news conference, saying the "attacks on our fanbase have no basis in reality."

stories.title: Pitt 'heartbroken' after QB Heintschel lost for season with torn ACL
stories.summary: Pitt quarterback Mason Heintschel, one of the top young quarterbacks in college football, will miss the remainder of the season with a torn ACL, the team said.
